newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel losing energy, block at 130.12.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel losing energy, block at 130.12.

text.p: The June notionnel contract on the MATIF is likely to lose momentum and will have difficulty getting above a 130.12 high set early on Monday, analysts said.
A Paris broker said that with Bunds having troubles of their own above the 102.00 area, the French contract would probably stall.
"If the Bunds stay on these levels (101.96 at 0758 GMT) it will be quite difficult to go through 130.12," he said.
At 0758 GMT, the June notionnel futures were at 130.06, up 0.32 from the prior close. Traders said weekend polls pointing to a centre right election win were giving the market a boost.
Marc Ostwald at London Bond Broking said the notionnel may push higher, but agreed it would soon run out of momentum.
He put initial resistance at the 130.16,18 congestion area which he said would likely hold. If it does break, the market would target 130.64, he added.
Charts show the market reached a daily low of 130.64 on February 27 and March 3, and a high at that level on March 5.
On the downside, support comes in at 129.66, the highs last Tuesday and Wednesday.
"Then below that there's fairly substantial congestion at 129.26,32," said Ostwald.
The June Pibor contract was up seven basis from the prior close at 96.41, while the September futures were up 0.05 at 96.48.
The June contract gapped up on Monday, leaving a space between a 96.35 high on Friday and a 96.40 low so far on Monday. It faces resistance from a May 2 high at 96.45.
